worldcombat.skill.banefulbunker.summary: A venomous wall closes into a bunker, blocking attacks and status moves by a total pool; every direct contact poisons the attacker, and an already poisoned one is worsened to toxic.
worldcombat.skill.banefulbunker.descript: The bunker lasts %1$s and holds %2$s points; contact poisons for %3$s. Higher Defence makes it thicker and longer, higher Special Attack poisons longer.
Repeat-use failure rate %1$s; the venomous/thick trade-off is the %2$s setting.
worldcombat.skill.banefulbunker.use.0: Bait a melee foe onto the venomous wall
worldcombat.skill.banefulbunker.use.1: Drag a foe into a lasting damage-over-time with one contact
worldcombat.skill.banefulbunker.use.2: Seal a status move while venom pours back
worldcombat.skill.banefulbunker.preferen: On (venomous): venom duration x1.35, but pool x0.8, duration x0.85, recover 8 ticks. Off (thick): pool x1.25, duration x1.15, recover 5 ticks, but venom x0.8.
Close the bunker once a threat enters this range. Larger sets up earlier but may waste the cast; smaller saves PP but bets the foe will close in.
world_combat.move.banefulbunker.text.war: The venom wall sealed the status move
